title: Paper cut-out
description: Shapes that look cut from paper or card, with visible edges, simple shadows and fine paper grain.

art_style.outline_policy: No ink outline; a thin lighter paper edge instead.
art_style.shading_policy: Soft drop shadow under each layer; flat colour on each paper piece.
art_style.texture_policy: Fine paper grain at one consistent scale.

native_size_guidance: Draw at about twice the final display size and reduce once with a smooth filter; keep every asset in a set at the same scale.
avoid: Do not use gradients inside a paper piece.
Do not draw fine detail a paper cutter could not cut.
